hook: apocryphal 是假古董傳聞，apoplectic 是氣到中風——編輯台兩盞燈：假的、氣的。
script: apocryphal＝偽／不可信的。apoplectic＝大怒的／中風的。prophetic 預言。prophylactic 預防。口令：假新聞燈寫「別信」，血壓燈寫「先喝水」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假新聞燈: apocryphal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假新聞燈」出場：apocryphal 一上場梗就黏住——偽的不可信。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 血壓燈: apoplectic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「血壓燈」出場：apoplectic 一上場梗就黏住——大怒的。

members.senseAnchor: correctly saying what will happen in the future
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 預言麥: prophetic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「預言麥」出場：prophetic 一上場梗就黏住——預言的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 預防針: prophylactic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「預防針」出場：prophylactic 一上場梗就黏住——預防的。

members.senseAnchor: lacking authenticity or validity in essence or origin
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假章: spurious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假章」出場：spurious 一上場梗就黏住——偽造的。

related.synonyms: apocryphal, bogus, counterfeit, forged, phony, specious
